blockers.finding: The CLI approve command currently accepts --approver-role APPROVAL_ADMIN as a caller-supplied string without independent cryptographic or IAM verification of the caller's authentic identity.
blockers.remediation_required: Implement out-of-band operator identity authentication (e.g. mutual TLS client certificates, OIDC/SAML signed claims, or cryptographic hardware key signatures) before production sign-off.

blockers.finding: Operator production authorization has not been granted. Policy freeze remains in effect.
